stories.title: One hospitalized after fire at Montreal apartment building
stories.summary: The fire began around 3:30 p.m. in Montreal's Pierrefonds-Roxboro borough, on Riviera Street at the corner of Riverdale Boulevard.

stories.title: No complaint received by ombudsman after children allegedly confined in locker
stories.summary: Quebec's ombudsman's office says it won't be able to investigate or issue recommendations until a parent or student files a complaint.

stories.title: Quebec police investigate Granby shooting that left one dead, one injured
stories.summary: A man in his 30s is dead and a woman was badly injured after what police are calling a targeted shooting in Granby, in the province's Eastern Townships.

stories.title: Ontario’s medical regulator pauses safer supply drug changes after legal challenge
stories.summary: Ontario’s medical regulator is hitting pause on implementing a host of changes to the ways doctors prescribe safer supply drugs after it was served with a legal challenge.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Mack urges Fajardo to return after Grey Cup win
stories.summary: They had such a good time this season that Austin Mack can't see why Cody Fajardo would want to step away from the Edmonton Elks.

stories.title: Telus conducting ‘thorough review’ of $31B takeover offer from Québecor
stories.summary: Quebecor has sent an unsolicited offer to acquire Telus in a merger deal valued at approximately $31 billion, which represents an enhanced proposal from June.

stories.title: Montreal Opposition wants city to appoint executive responsible for systemic racism
stories.summary: The Opposition at Montreal’s City Hall will ask Soraya Martinez Ferrada’s administration to name a point person on its executive committee to address systemic racism.

stories.title: Montreal sputters late, loses Grey Cup again
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' potent offence sputtered in the fourth quarter and the team went home from the Grey Cup empty-handed a second straight year.

stories.title: Philpot named Grey Cup’s top Canadian in defeat
stories.summary: There was no consolation for Tyson Philpot after he was named the Grey Cup's most valuable Canadian in a losing cause Sunday night.
